posts.author: OutWoods
posts.body:
I'm making a game in RPG Maker MV, but the default text speed feels too fast for the pacing I want.
Is there a way to slow down the text speed
globally
for the entire game?
(I know about using characters like \. or \! to pause specific lines, but I am looking for a setting or plugin that changes the default speed for all dialogue automatically.)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Have you tried googling text speed plugin at all? The first result seems to go to a thread, linking multiple possibilities.
MV - RMMV - Text Speed/Draw Speed plugin?
Hello!  IS there a FREE plugin that can change text speed? - I asking this cuz:  Not just in game options but in dev mode too, so you can change it, how you like it? So like you can do something like wait 1 sec after every word? exemp: L wait I wait L wait E  I do know a few that already do...
